Police Family.name: Police Family
Police Family.description:
👮 You are the child of a police officer: at a neighborhood police box, in a detective squad or with the riot police.

⚖️ You grew up with the law and the way detectives think.
🦸 You also learned the police view of heroes.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Hero Law +5, Investigation +5
Police Family.traitNarrativeEffects: A parent is a police officer: original, never canon. The player may define them; else the narrator sets post (police-box officer, ward detective or riot police), personality and firm view of heroes that shaped the character. On duty, police never use Quirks as weapons: heroes do most Quirk-villain fighting; police arrest, investigate, detain, file paperwork. Officers may respect heroes or resent their credit and damage. In play: officers who know the parent know the character (favors, scrutiny); case files never leak, but home talk reveals police worries; using the parent's name to dodge trouble backfires on both. Paths: illegal Quirk use reaches the parent; a vigilante or villain path puts the parent between child and oath, a conflict the narrator plays honestly and never resolves for the player; a hero: respect from some officers, suspicion from those who say heroes steal cases. Childhood: nameless cases at dinner, missed holidays, curfews, a lie-spotting parent.
